# Hostile and damaged PDFs — results of October 25, 2026 (release audit, test 10)

**Checker:** `scripts/check-hostile-pdfs.mjs`, run through the built app with `agent-run`. All 18 files are generated by
the script; no real documents are used.

**What each file must do:**
- open, or be refused with a message, within 45 seconds
- not run anything (`tasklist` is checked for calc.exe and run-me.exe; there are no network requests)
- in Build, Fill and sign opens or refuses with a message within 30 seconds
- a good PDF opens afterwards

`HOSTILE_ONLY=<regex>` reruns chosen files.

**Result: 18/18 pass** (full run at the end of October 25, plus targeted reruns while fixing the checker).

| File | What it tries | PDFix |
|---|---|---|
| truncated-half | valid PDF cut in half | refused with a message, 0.5 s |
| broken-xref | every cross-reference offset wrong | repaired and shown; Fill and sign: 0 fields |
| page-tree-loop | page tree contains itself | refused: "Pages tree contains circular reference." |
| reference-loop | bookmark that points to itself forever | shown; Fill and sign works |
| huge-page | page 1e9 × 1e9 points | shown; Fill and sign refuses safely ("damaged or protected", all controls off) |
| zero-page | zero/negative page size | shown; Fill and sign refuses safely ("A page has an invalid visible…") |
| million-pages-claimed | page count says 1,000,000, has 1 | shown, 1 page; Fill and sign works |
| flate-bomb | content stream inflating to 60 MB | shown in 0.8 s; Fill and sign works |
| lying-image | image claims 100,000 × 100,000 pixels from 1 KB | refused with a message |
| deep-nesting | 50,000 nested arrays | refused with a message |
| javascript-actions | JavaScript on open, launch calc.exe, submit to a web address | shown; **nothing ran, no request** |
| uri-on-open | opens a web address on open | shown; **no request** |
| attached-exe | attached .exe with a launch action | shown; **the program did not run** |
| garbage-font | embedded font is random bytes | shown; Fill and sign works |
| broken-encryption | unknown encryption method | refused: "unknown encryption method" |
| five-thousand-notes | 5,000 notes on one page | shown; Fill and sign refuses: "A page has too many annotations." |
| xfa-only | dynamic XFA form only | shown; Fill and sign: "XFA forms are unsupported. Request a regular fillable PDF." |
| not-a-pdf-but-named-pdf | a program renamed .pdf | refused with a message |

## Small issues found (not failures)

1. **Engine wording reaches the user (reader, Codex).** "Pages tree contains circular reference." and "unknown encryption
   method" are raw engine messages. Plainer: "This PDF is damaged and can't be shown. Your original is unchanged." /
   "This PDF uses a kind of encryption PDFix doesn't support."
2. **Save a copy and Print stay clickable** on a PDF that could not be read (reader, Codex).
3. **Fill and sign's refusal message sits mid-panel** among greyed-out buttons, and says "owner-authorized unrestricted
   copy" (Claude). Better: the message at the top in plain words, the disabled controls hidden.

## Not covered by this run

- Every other save route on these files (only open and Fill and sign).
- Very large real-world damaged files.
- A fuzzing campaign. This is a fixed corpus of known tricks.
- The memory used by the flate bomb was not measured (it rendered in 0.8 s).
